description: This file implements classes and methods for handling NR PPA (Positioning Protocol for NR) protocol messages, including encoding, decoding, and JSON serialization. It defines structures for initiating messages, outcomes, and the overall PDU, with specific procedures identified by procedure codes.

classes.name: nr_ppa_elem_procs_o
classes.description: Contains static methods for mapping procedure codes to message types and handling procedure-specific logic.

classes.name: init_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the initiating message with procedure code, criticality, transaction ID, and specific message content.

classes.name: successful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents a successful outcome message with procedure code, criticality, transaction ID, and specific response content.

classes.name: unsuccessful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents an unsuccessful outcome message with procedure code, criticality, transaction ID, and specific failure content.

classes.name: nr_ppa_pdu_c
classes.description: Main class representing the NR PPA Protocol Data Unit, which can be an initiating message, successful outcome, or unsuccessful outcome.

methods.name: idx_to_proc_code
methods.description: Maps an index to a procedure code.

methods.name: is_proc_code_valid
methods.description: Checks if a procedure code is valid.

methods.name: get_init_msg
methods.description: Returns the initiating message type for a given procedure code.

methods.name: get_successful_outcome
methods.description: Returns the successful outcome type for a given procedure code.

methods.name: get_unsuccessful_outcome
methods.description: Returns the unsuccessful outcome type for a given procedure code.

methods.name: get_crit
methods.description: Returns the criticality value for a given procedure code.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the message into a bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the message from a bit buffer.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the message to JSON format.

methods.name: load_info_obj
methods.description: Loads message info based on procedure code.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the message type and initializes content accordingly.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Copy assignment operator for the main PDU class.

methods.name: set_init_msg
methods.description: Sets the PDU as an initiating message.

methods.name: set_successful_outcome
methods.description: Sets the PDU as a successful outcome.

methods.name: set_unsuccessful_outcome
methods.description: Sets the PDU as an unsuccessful outcome.
